library.svg.method: Evaluated original B3_VOL, b3_SP and cloth/foil drawing masks. Cropped to four actual volumes. Original OKLCH base inks converted to sRGB. Optical flat-vector material proof: dynamic light, woven stock relief and foil reflections omitted at icon size; Archivo falls back to Arial.

gallery.svg.method: Original PR.buildField seed17 dark.26 contrast1.5 and Comp.dotScreen angle22.5 pitch5 gain.72. Source canvas field commands evaluated with a small pixel compositor (radial gradient source-over and approximate antialiased stroke coverage), then original per-pixel shading. Original sphere paper, ultramarine ink, orange registration ring and cross preserved. Circle clip baked into exact dot-circle intersections; coordinates rounded to .001. Outer poster removed. Small rasterization differences from browser canvas are possible.

meshviz.svg.method: Executed original SVG drawing helpers and figIso object block using a document serializer, without a browser. Removed annotations and cropped the actual illustration. Original inks and fills. All stroke widths multiplied2.5 for small-size legibility. Library exemplar, not a pre-existing MeshViz logo.
